S107.13.needs: A second account in the same workspace
S107.13.note: Only the sharer name, message count and expiry are shown; no version, source or "copied from" text was found in the code, and the exact share-link button label in the dialog was not verified.
steps: Sign in with account A, open a conversation, and click "Share conversation" in the chat header.
In the dialog, choose a workspace or organization share and create the link.
Sign in with account B in the same workspace (or open the link in a new window) and open the link.
Look under the title for "Shared by <name>", "<n> messages" and "Expires <time>". Compare with Expected: publisher, author, source, versions and "copied from" were not found on this page.
S107.13.where: Chat header > "Share conversation", then open the share link as a second account. The viewer shows "Shared by <name>", the message count and "Expires".

S107.15.needs: A conversation that already has an AI reply
S107.15.note: No report control was found on public share pages, and the code only sends category harmful. Infringement reports are not offered here.
steps: Sign in, open a conversation that has an AI reply.
Hover or click the AI reply, then click the "More message actions" button.
Click "Report this response". The item changes to "Reporting…" and then "Reported".
Compare with Expected: the report is sent to /api/content-report with category harmful. Confirming it reaches operators needs the operator dashboard (see S107.23).
S107.15.where: An AI reply > "More message actions" > "Report this response". Report is offered only on AI replies, not on public share pages.

S107.20.needs: A plugin you created that is submittable
S107.20.note: The exact Settings path to the directory was inferred from the nav labels, not confirmed in the directory's own code. The user-added publisher source was not found; the Partners page is a public marketing page, not an in-app screen.
steps: Sign in, open Settings, and choose "Plugins".
Open a plugin you created so its detail page shows.
Click "Submit to the directory" and confirm in the dialog.
Look for the submission note and the review note on the plugin page. Compare with Expected: the publisher is named and the submission goes to review.
S107.20.where: Settings > Plugins > open a plugin you created > "Submit to the directory". Public information: the "Partners" page (site navigation) says "List a plugin in the directory".

S107.23.note: The tab's visible label for the content tab was not found, so the tester should look for the content tab by its contents. The admin console also lists a "Content report queue" and "Content takedown" entry in apps/web/features/admin/pages/AdminConsolePage.tsx, which the audit did not confirm as the same path.
steps: Sign in with a staff operator account and open /operator.
Open the content tab, which holds the "Rights notices" list.
Pick a notice, read its details, and choose a status; for an unpublish, click "Unpublish" and confirm the dialog.
Compare with Expected: the notice is reviewed here and the public item is taken down, with the decision recorded in the audit log.
S107.23.where: Operator dashboard (/operator) > content tab > "Rights notices" (staff account only).
